scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' SIGINT; bun run dev:backend & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.dev:web: cd apps/web && bunx dotenv-cli -e ../../.env -- bunx vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
scripts.generate:openapi: bun scripts/generate-openapi-json.ts && bunx openapi-typescript apps/backend/openapi.yaml -o packages/api-types/src/openapi.ts
